v7.0.0

What's Changed

  • Bump flatted from 3.3.1 to 3.4.2 by @​dependabot[bot] in actions/checkout#2460
  • Bump js-yaml from 4.1.0 to 4.2.0 by @​dependabot[bot] in actions/checkout#2461

pull_requests.title: Stop dependency scans for absent root manifests
pull_requests.body: Remove monthly root npm and pip jobs that have no supported dependency manifests. Preserve the weekly GitHub Actions job and its five-PR limit unchanged. Seven nested skill package manifests were parsed; all have no dependencies, and no supported Python dependency manifest or lockfile exists in the tracked tree. Update the two affected AGENTS statements to match. YAML and scope checks passed, with no application or skill changes. This addresses the missing-package.json updater failure, not unrelated inventory drift or pending Actions major upgrades. Hosted Dependabot execution will be verified separately; no claim that a historical alert is already cleared.

pull_requests.title: Refresh technology release baselines
pull_requests.body:
## Summary

- Update the Python release baseline to 3.14.8 and npm to 12.2.0.
- Refresh the review date and list Node.js/npm helper tooling in the Markdown inventory.
- Keep the entries as release observations, not claims about installed versions.

## Evidence

- Python 3.14.8 release: https://www.python.org/downloads/release/python-3148/
- npm 12.2.0 registry page: https://www.npmjs.com/package/npm?activeTab=versions
- npm 12.2.0 release: https://github.com/npm/cli/releases

## Validation

- `python3 .github/scripts/test_technology_inventory.py` (4 tests passed)
- `python3 .github/scripts/check-technology-inventory.py --max-age-days 90` (current, all configured source lookups parsed)
- `python3 .agents/skills/okhp3-skill-cataloger/scripts/gen-skills-readme.py --skills-dir .agents/skills --check` (passed)
- `python3 -m json.tool docs/maintenance/technology-inventory.json` (passed)
- `git diff --check` (passed)

## Copilot review overview ### 🟡 Changes recommended The forward-dated external version claims (Python 3.14.8, npm 12.2.0, Node.js 24.21.0) cannot be verified without network access and rely on CI's live-source checker, so final human confirmation of the baselines is warranted before approval. **Review effort:** Balanced **Findings:** None
What changed in this PR This PR refreshes the repository's technology inventory to record newer upstream release baselines and a current review date. It fits into the documentation-only maintenance workflow where `docs/maintenance/technology-inventory.json` is the machine-readable source of truth consumed by `.github/scripts/check-technology-inventory.py`, and `docs/maintenance/TECHNOLOGY.md` is the human-readable companion. The values are explicitly framed as release observations, not claims about installed versions. **Changes:** - Updates the Python baseline (3.14.7 → 3.14.8) and npm baseline (12.0.2 → 12.2.0) in both the JSON and Markdown inventories. - Advances the review/baseline-check dates to 2026-10-01 (`reviewed_on`, `release_baselines_checked_on`, and the Markdown header). - Adds the previously missing Node.js LTS and npm rows to the Markdown table so it matches the JSON's monitored publishers, and updates the reconciliation prose. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | docs/​maintenance/​technology-inventory.json | Bumps Python and npm `latest_stable_as_of_review` values and both review dates in the checker's source of truth. | | docs/​maintenance/​TECHNOLOGY.md | Mirrors the version/date updates and adds Node.js LTS and npm rows plus reconciliation prose for parity with the JSON. | Consistency verification: the Markdown table (12 rows) matches the JSON's 12 technologies; Python 3.14.8, npm 12.2.0, and Node.js 24.21.0 agree across the table, JSON, and reconciliation paragraph; the JSON parses cleanly; and no stale `3.14.7`/`12.0.2`/`2026-09-20` references remain except the test fixtures in `test_technology_inventory.py`, which exercise parsing logic (prerelease filtering, gzip decoding) rather than live baselines and correctly stay unchanged.
